description: Anonymous, read-only eBay public XHR scope. Search suggestions and query-linked category hints are live-replayed. Product listings, item detail, category browsing and result pagination require a separate observed and independently replayed XHR contract; eBay's SSR pages do not satisfy the API-only gate.

capabilities.title: Read public keyword suggestions and query-linked category hints without a login or developer token
capabilities.note: The live response contains suggestions and optional category hints, not product search results or a complete category taxonomy.

capabilities.title: Search product listings through an anonymous XHR endpoint
capabilities.blocker: Current anonymous search page returns item listings in HTML; no independently replayed XHR listing endpoint observed.

capabilities.title: Read item details and current price through anonymous XHR
capabilities.blocker: No anonymous item-detail XHR response schema and direct replay established.

capabilities.title: Read browse categories through anonymous XHR
capabilities.blocker: No anonymous category XHR response schema and direct replay established.

capabilities.title: Traverse search results with bounded XHR pagination
capabilities.blocker: Search result pagination is currently a document route, not an observed XHR contract.

capabilities.title: Read secondary listing images from the observed auxiliary XHR
capabilities.note: The browser request includes a pageci value and listing IDs from the HTML page. A standalone anonymous input source and replay are unverified.

capabilities.title: Sign in to a buyer or seller account
capabilities.applicabilityReason: The user explicitly scoped the marketplace integration to public reads without login.

capabilities.title: Cart, bid, order, address or seller mutation
capabilities.applicabilityReason: The user requested only public anonymous reads; account and transaction writes are outside the authorized scope.
